description: This file defines an enum 'FieldType' that specifies various data types (INT, INT16, BIT, FLOAT) and provides methods to retrieve corresponding command strings for load and store operations.

classes.name: FieldType
classes.description: An enumeration representing different field data types with utility methods to generate command strings.

methods.name: getTypeForCommand
methods.description: Returns the string representation ('float' or 'int') based on the FieldType instance.

methods.name: getLoadCommand
methods.description: Returns the load command string, e.g., 'get_int' or 'get_float', depending on the field type.

methods.name: getStoreCommand
methods.description: Returns the store command string, e.g., 'set_int' or 'set_float', depending on the field type.
